name: Corner cafe (cafe-tabac)
description: Corner cafe-tabac, 12 x 10.4 m: a painted timber shopfront with tall glazed bays, a lettered fascia and red-and-cream striped awnings on the street and the corner side, two cafe tables with chairs and a chalk menu board on the pavement, ochre render with iron balconettes above, a modillion cornice and a slate mansard roof with zinc rolls and dormers. The cafe room below with a street door and a corner door, two rooms above, two stairs.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
